details:
VREdit As I would title it, would be a way to simply create a world without the complex effort of shaping, coding, and building the world from scratch like you would normally.  It would start with a build baseplate of a flat plane with a certain size, and an online repository of materials, textures, and effects that would be uploaded by users and shown in a gallery.  Users can upload textures, objects, logics, and other things to make interesting immersive VR worlds whether on a PC or VR headset.  In Headset clients, logic would be made using a tool similar to Gmod's wiring tool and logic pack.  Basically tie wires together using VR and once the tool is deselected, the wiring disappears.  Wanna make a room?  Just draw it using a square at a time.  Need an object?  Pick one from the gallery of user uploaded objects.  Need some logic to make a game or cool effects?  Pick up the logic tool and get to work!  Click the "Test" button to instantly switch to experience mode, where you can suss out any bugs in your world.  Once you're done, you can immediately publish the world to VRChat, and have it show up in your worlds that you published.
The perfect, easy-to-use VR world building platform for VRChat.
It can be used either by desktop or in VR.  So simple even a Quest user can build a VR world.
title: Add a VR Worldbuilder which makes online world development easy and accessible.
